rules.passwordHash: xsha256i salted iterated hash with passwordHashIterations; xsha256/xrt64/plaintext compatible
rules.paidMode: returns payRequired and price; allows trusted session claim from paidSessionKey
rules.listLimit: admin rule list clamps request limit by maxListRows
rules.adminRuleFilters: admin rule list supports optional targetType/targetId/accessMode/status filters with bound SQL and maxListRows limit
rules.passwordInputLimit: admin save and public password check clamp password bytes by maxPasswordInputBytes
rules.requestLimit: admin rule save/delete reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
rules.modeValidation: admin rule save accepts only public/login/level/group/password/paid/private modes
rules.statusValidation: admin rule save normalizes status to enabled(1) or disabled(0)
rules.adminStats: access.rule.stats returns rule totals, content/category rule counts and access mode aggregates for admin diagnostics
rules.adminStatsUi: ability page renders rule totals and access mode aggregates as tables, while retaining raw JSON for diagnostics
rules.readLevelSource: session authLevel/__authLevel__ by default; readLevel query override only when allowQueryReadLevel is enabled for debugging
rules.readLevelLimit: level rules and runtime read level are clamped by maxReadLevel
